svg.title: Space between parts, and the shadow of a tall part
svg.desc: Drawn to scale. Left, top view: small capacitors placed 1 mm from the edge of a BGA and 1 mm from each other. Right, side view: a 10 mm tall aluminum capacitor. Light from an inspection camera's angled projector is blocked by the tall part, so a small resistor right beside it sits in its shadow and can't be measured; a resistor further away is in clear view.

g.text: About 1 mm from the BGA and each other
A part here can't be measured
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Everyday spacing: about 1 mm edge to edge (PCB-DFA-023).
The shadow's length depends on the camera's angle.
